home.title: Welcome to TK Books
home.subtitle: The books, songs, tests and review sheets for teaching English – in one place, with one link. No more heavy files by email.

f.songsText: Songs with lyrics and audio for every unit.
f.testsText: Ready-made tests to download and print.
